correctness.rationale: PASS: Exhausted all 511 coefficient masks by four-chart exact Groebner unit-ideal smoothness, independently reproducing exactly 144 smooth curves. Rebuilt full PGL2(F2)^2 semidirect swap action and its six disjoint orbits; computed 144 rational fibres and two deck involution permutations and recovered all six table rows (representatives 98,99,113,121,122,186; profile orders 3,5,2,2,4,2 respectively). On a genus-one curve with rational origin, each ruling involution is P↦Q_i−P, so their composite is translation by Q_y−Q_x, and its action on the rational origin detects global order; bounded point permutation alone was not used as a global proof. The two-ruling separability and characteristic-two branching are accounted for.
